correctness.rationale: For R(z)=1+z+z²/2+z³/6+z⁴/24, the claimed matrix is T_G(h)=R(−hL_G). Taylor integral remainder gives R(−x)>0 for x>=0, hence all diagonal entries stay positive. Four-step walk locality reduces every path/cycle distance-one and -two entry to seven cubics/five quadratics; their Bernstein coefficients on [0,2/3] are positive. The enumerated distance-three coefficients vanish at 2/3,4/7,1/2 for large enough paths/cycles and become strictly negative thereafter. P2,P3,C3,C4,C5 have an explicitly checked unique positive cubic root with other off-diagonal entries nonnegative globally. Independent exact rational matrix-power enumeration of paths and cycles through n=12 corroborated every exceptional and stable cutoff; the infinite classification follows from walk locality, not those tests.
